_comment: 动物小镇五关音频台词表。voice: rabbit=小兔孩童音，beaver=河狸温和成年音。每条 key 对应一个 m4a 文件。

lines.text: Hi, Beaver!
Hello, little rabbit! What can I do for you?
I want to have a party. I need some books.
Look. A book can be on the cart.
Or it can be next to the cart.
Now you try. Listen for on or next to.
You are doing great!
Nice listening! Now let us use the box.
The words are the same: on, next to.
Time to ask for the book. Say it with me.
Here you go. It's due on Friday.
Thank you, Beaver! See you at the party!
Have a great party!
book
cart
The book is on the cart.
The book is next to the cart.
Tap the book on the cart.
Tap the book on the box.
Tap the book next to the cart.
Tap the book next to the box.
Can I check this out, please?
Well done!
Hello! I need some food for the party.
Hi, little rabbit! What would you like?
I would like a bread roll for the party.
One or two? Listen for the number.
Now you try. Listen for the number.
Now take the paper bag. It is next to the basket.
Now order with me.
Here you are. Two rolls!
Thank you! See you at the party!
Bye! Have fun.
a bread roll
a loaf of bread
One roll.
Two rolls.
Tap the bag next to the basket.
Two rolls, please.
Well done!
Excuse me. How do I get to the party?
Hello! I can help you. At the crossing, you can turn left, turn right, or go straight.
Turn left.
Turn right.
Go straight.
Now follow the map. At the first crossing, listen carefully.
You need a map first. Listen where it is.
Now say it with me.
You made it! There is the party.
Thank you! See you at the party!
Bye! See you there.
Turn left.
Turn right.
Go straight.
Tap the map on the bench.
Tap the map next to the bench.
Not this way. Let us go back.
Go straight, please.
Well done!
Hello!
Hi there! Welcome to the market.
Here is your party list. We take two things in order.
Listen for first and then, and put them in the basket.
Now say it with me.
Here are your things. Great job!
Thank you! See you at the party!
Bye! See you there.
apple
milk
cheese
egg
First, take the apple. Then, take the milk.
First, take the milk. Then, take the cheese.
First, take the egg. Then, take the apple.
First, take the cheese. Then, take the milk.
The apples are on the shelf.
First, take the apples, please.
Well done!
Hello! Happy birthday, Beaver!
Welcome! Today is my birthday. Thank you for coming.
A few little jobs first. Listen carefully.
Now let us sing together.
What a great birthday! Thank you.
Happy birthday, Beaver! See you soon!
Bye bye!
Put the book on the table.
Take two balloons.
Go straight to the cake.
First, put the present next to the cake. Then, light the candle.
Happy birthday, Beaver!
Well done!
